title: Exercise the user's actual presets without loading the desktop effect
goal: The user can establish whether selected existing Slang presets load and render through the production Odin runtime before installing the native desktop module.

criteria.text: The user's nearest preset preserves a spatial 128x72 RGBA input at absolute tolerance0.003 over8frames; rejecting a missing preset does not prevent subsequent renders of that existing chain.

The selected real NTSC, phosphorlut, guest-advanced and CyberLab presets with their existing assets load and render8frames each with finite readback; metadata and an SDR-clamped preview are captured, without claiming artistic or HDR fidelity.
Successful selected-preset runs restore host EGL context and viewport after rendering, explicitly destroy shader resources and the host EGL objects, and finish with known supervised process cleanup.

out_of_scope: Mutter or GNOME51 integration, installed-app/physical-output validation
Performance comparison, HDR/artistic equivalence or all-preset compatibility
Host deployment, package/Nix operations, desktop changes or old experiment replay
decisions: Personal local installation is the destination; the existing shader folder is user-supplied test input.
This standalone utility uses the unchanged production shared runtime, not synthetic C stubs or the closed fixed-fixture executable.
Scope and behavioral criteria were recorded in trial scope.json before implementation; this file maps that promise to named tests.
